jobs.name: cand1_monet_dawn
jobs.direction: 方向 A · 晨光（莫奈 单模块）
jobs.theme: A small independent cafe opening visual: a quiet street-side cafe corner at early morning, a small round table beside a tall window, one ceramic cup of coffee with gentle rising steam, soft hazy light after rain, warm broken reflections on the wet pavement.

jobs.name: cand2_vermeer_monet_windowlight
jobs.direction: 方向 B · 窗光（维米尔 70% × 莫奈 30%）
jobs.theme: A small cafe opening visual: the quiet everyday moment of pouring steamed milk from a small pitcher into a ceramic cup of coffee, at a wooden table beside a tall window on the left; one person seen from the side at close range, absorbed in the action; a small pastry on a plate; gentle steam rising; soft daylight.
jobs.fusion: Fusion of two painterly languages: Johannes Vermeer dominant (70%), Claude Monet secondary (30%).
jobs.axis_note: Claude Monet contributes only the atmospheric envelope: in the far distance the contrast is compressed and all colour is gathered toward one soft airy warm tone; no broken brushwork and no comma strokes.
jobs.main_segment: quiet Dutch Golden Age interior genre scene, single figure (one or two people) absorbed in a silent everyday action, soft natural daylight entering from a single window on the LEFT, large pale plaster wall catching the light, high-key tonality, deep shadows rendered as flat unmodulated areas of cool blue-grey paint (no detail inside shadows), dominant colour pair of natural ultramarine blue and ochre yellow with tiny red accents, specular highlights painted as small round globular dots (pointillés) on porcelain, pewter, brass, pearls and bread crust, soft edges with no hard contour lines (sfumato, details deliberately omitted), matte and glossy surfaces distinguished only by the shape of their highlights, single-point perspective grid of tiled floor (29.3 cm tiles) and leaded window frames, thin translucent glazes over a light grey ground, smooth levigated paint surface with the canvas weave barely visible, dark neutral or deep green backdrop pushing the figure forward, timeless stillness, 17th-century Delft domestic world, oil on canvas, museum-quality

jobs.name: cand3_matisse_colorblocks
jobs.direction: 方向 C · 色块（马蒂斯 单模块）
jobs.theme: A small cafe opening poster: a large warm sun disc above a simple ceramic cup of coffee, with a leaf, a star and flowing organic shapes gathering around a beam of warm light, on a cream paper ground.
jobs.main_segment: paper cut-out composition in the manner of Matisse's late gouache découpée: flat opaque gouache colours, shapes cut with scissors from hand-painted paper, absolutely no shading, no gradients, no outlines, no drop shadows; a small set of 5-7 fully saturated colours (ultramarine blue, cadmium red, emerald green, lemon yellow, black, white); large interlocking organic silhouettes; every curve answers to an implied vertical axis; generous white paper ground visible between shapes (at least 20% of the surface); whole composition legible at a glance; poster-like flatness, matte surface, slightly irregular scissor edges; dancer / snail / leaf / star motifs allowed
